request_json.message: Is it allowed to wash battery acid down the floor drain?

response_json.response:
❌ NON-COMPLIANT
• Rule: SOP-HAZ-001 §2 — do not flush chemical spills down the drain.
• Action: alert the Floor Supervisor and use the Acid Neutralizing Spill Kit (Pillar 14 or Building 5 Quarantine Spill Berm).
